pages.title: Spacetime Alloy Ingot
pages.text: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its surface reflects distant stars instead of the room around it, because part of its structure is folded spacetime. It is heavier than its size suggests, and gently warps the light around its edges.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I cracked a Block of Spacetime Alloy into ingots by hand and found the stars in its reflection had shifted slightly. Each ingot shows a different patch of sky.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Block of Spacetime Alloy, Compactification Lathe, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Degenerate Armour Plate, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Spacetime Alloy Coil Block, Spacetime Anchor Core and more.
